title: trackerScheduleHold
responsibility: Read and describe Tracker launch pauses using the schedule journal clock and manual-intake policy.

inputs.name: trackerScheduleHold.row
inputs.description: Stored scheduling fields and the journal clocks for the opt-out and its reason.

inputs.name: trackerScheduleHold.now
inputs.description: Current Unix time in milliseconds for testing the expiry boundary.

inputs.name: describeTrackerScheduleHold.reason
inputs.description: Reason for the active operator pause or manual intake policy.

inputs.name: describeTrackerScheduleHold.until
inputs.description: Expiry in ISO 8601 format, or null for a manual-intake policy.

outputs.name: manualIntakeReason
outputs.description: Shared label for an intake policy that requires an explicit launch.

outputs.name: trackerScheduleHold
outputs.type: { reason: string; until: string | null } | null
outputs.description: Active pause reason and expiry, or null when there is no active pause.

outputs.name: describeTrackerScheduleHold
outputs.description: Display reason with the deadline appended for a temporary pause.
